examples: Put a different image behind each project's sessions so you know at a glance which one you are typing into.
how_to: Click the picture icon on the terminal bar (or, when the bar is too narrow, the three dots then background) to open the terminal background panel.
Choose an image and adjust how strongly it shows; it applies to that session only.
Clear it from the same panel.

name: Session background image
summary: set a custom background image behind a session's terminal.
where: Open a session, then the picture icon in its terminal bar; on a narrow bar it is the background item in the three-dot menu.
